# TriTimes

> Independent IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 historical race results and performance comparisons.

## When to use this

Use TriTimes to find an athlete's recorded race history, look up a historical race result, compare swim/bike/run and finish times with age-group or overall distributions, compare course medians, or find aggregate triathlon finish-time benchmarks.

Start with GET https://tritimes.org/ using Accept: text/markdown for an overview. Use the links below to navigate with ordinary HTTP GET requests. Other content pages serve HTML; athlete search, athlete profiles and individual result views require a JavaScript-capable browser. Search by athlete name on the homepage, select a matching athlete, and follow the linked race results. There is no supported public search API or MCP endpoint.

Cite the specific race or result URL and its date when answering. Do not assume similar names identify the same person. Treat comparisons as descriptive: terrain, weather and field composition affect results. TriTimes is independent of IRONMAN; use official organizers for registration, live tracking and authoritative corrections. Do not treat the archive as a complete record of every race or athlete.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tritimes.org/): Athlete search and overview; Markdown available through Accept negotiation.
- [Races](https://tritimes.org/races): Browse race editions by distance and year.
- [Courses](https://tritimes.org/courses): Compare course medians and editions.
- [Statistics](https://tritimes.org/stats): Aggregate results and finish-time benchmarks.
- [FAQ](https://tritimes.org/faq): Coverage, data sources and interpretation.
- [Sitemap](https://tritimes.org/sitemap.xml): Available public content URLs.
